name: תחום הגדרה – שורש של טרינום ריבועי במכנה (ב) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
For the following function, what is the domain determined by the domain convention?

\[ f({{CT:0}}) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{{{CT:1}}-{{CT:2}} {{CT:0}} -{{CT:0}}^2}} .\] Give your answer as a logical sequence of inequalities such as "\( x<= -11 \mbox{ or } x>13\)".

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
For the function to exist, the square root must exist and cannot be \(0\), hence

\[{{CT:1}}-{{CT:2}} {{CT:0}} -{{CT:0}}^2 = -({{CT:0}} + {{CT:3}})({{CT:0}} - {{CT:4}}) > 0.\] This is the case when \[ -{{CT:3}} < {{CT:0}} < {{CT:4}}\] This is entered as \({{CT:0}} \gt -{{CT:3}}\) and \({{CT:0}}\lt {{CT:4}}\). Enter \(-{{CT:3}} < {{CT:0}} \mbox{ and } {{CT:0}} < {{CT:4}}.\)
